title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler on Rivalry
items.text: Scottie Scheffler said his only real rival is the golf course and criticized personal jabs after Rory McIlroy called Bryson DeChambeau “performative” over a rules penalty.

items.headline: LIV Golf Team Finale Doubt
items.text: LIV Golf captain Martin Kaymer said the 2026 Team Championship is 95% likely to be canceled, putting Bryson DeChambeau’s future with LIV in question as he considers leaving after this season.
